name: Split Pitch Left
purpose: Get outside in a hurry. The far back trails the quarterback, takes the pitch on the run and turns up inside the block on the corner. Away from the split man there is nobody out there, so the near back goes and blocks that corner himself — which is why this side has no dive fake.

QB.rule: Open left, get to the edge, and pitch the ball to the trailing back before you get touched. There is no dive fake on this one — sell it with your eyes and get out there.

RH.rule: Run flat behind everybody, stay outside and behind the quarterback, and catch the pitch on the run. Never get ahead of him — a pitch that goes forward is a fumble.

coaching_points: The pitch goes early. A quarterback who waits to be tackled first will pitch it on the ground.
This is not a read at this age — tell him before the snap that he is pitching it.
The back taking the pitch must stay behind the quarterback until he has the ball. Getting ahead means the pitch goes forward, which is a fumble waiting to happen.

Everything depends on the corner being blocked and there is no receiver on this side to do it, so the near back leaves early and there is no fake to hold anybody. If their corner is quick, call it to the other side instead.
